subject: english
title: Pisni test: Unit 2 🍕 + ponovitev in sestavek
intro: Vse za pisni test: hrana in slovnica iz Unit 2, kratka ponovitev Starter in Unit 1 (to be, zaimki, množina, have got, can) in sestavek My family (13–15 povedi) brez tipičnih napak.
source: v2 (8 Nov 2026): rebuilt from all 33 Ang 2 photos: Wider World 1 SB Starter–2.7, WB Starter–2.5, notebook (teacher's task 'My family, 13 do 15 stavkov', Erik's own texts, to be, plurals, have got), and the seasons/on-in-at worksheet.

skills.title: how much / how many, a lot of
too much / too many / not enough
Starter: to be, zaimki, this/these, množina

learn.title: There is ali there are?
learn.text: There is (there's) = ena stvar ali nekaj neštevnega. There are = več stvari. Zanikanje: there isn't / there aren't. Vprašanje: Is there …? Are there …? Kratek odgovor: Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.
learn.example: There's a pizzeria in my town. There are two cafés. Is there a burger bar? No, there isn't.

learn.title: Števno ali neštevno?
learn.text: Števno (countable) lahko preštejemo: an apple, two apples. Neštevno (uncountable) ne: milk, water, bread, cheese, butter, rice, juice. Neštevno nima množine in nikoli a/an: some bread, NE a bread, NE breads.
learn.example: an egg → three eggs, a banana → bananas, but: some milk, some cheese

learn.title: a / an, some, any
learn.text: a/an = ena števna stvar (an pred a, e, i, o, u: an apple, an egg, an onion). some = nekaj, v trdilnih povedih. any = v zanikanih povedih in vprašanjih.
learn.example: There's an apple. There are some eggs. There isn't any milk. Are there any biscuits?

learn.title: How much ali how many?
learn.text: How many + množina (števno): How many eggs? How much + neštevno: How much milk? Za 'veliko' v trdilni povedi: a lot of / lots of (oboje). V zanikani: not many (števno), not much (neštevno).
learn.example: How many apples are there? There are a lot of apples. How much water is there? There isn't much water.

learn.title: too much, too many, not enough
learn.text: too much / too many = preveč (in to ni dobro). too much + neštevno, too many + množina. not enough = premalo.
learn.example: There's too much salt in this soup. There are too many chips on my plate. There isn't enough milk.

learn.title: Starter v eni minuti
learn.text: to be: I am, you/we/they are, he/she/it is. Zanikano: isn't, aren't. Vprašanje: Is he …? Are they …? Zaimki: I → me → my, he → him → his, she → her → her, we → us → our, they → them → their. this/these = blizu, that/those = daleč. Množina: child → children, man → men, woman → women, mouse → mice, knife → knives.
learn.example: They aren't from London. Look at them! Their names are Ana and Tom. These apples are good.

learn.title: Unit 1 v eni minuti
learn.text: have got: I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it HAS got. Zanikano: haven't got / hasn't got. Vprašanje: Has he got …? Yes, he has. can: enako za vse (he can, NE he cans). Vprašanje: Can you swim? Yes, I can. / No, I can't. Čigavo: my sister's name, Luke's car.
learn.example: My brother has got curly hair. He can play football but he can't swim. My mum's name is Daniela.

learn.title: Sestavek v 6 korakih
learn.text: 1 Uvod (There are four people in my family.) 2 Vsak član: ime, starost, od kod (My dad's name is …) 3 Videz s has got 4 Kaj zna s can / can't 5 Kaj rad ima, hrana (His favourite food is …) 6 Zaključek (I love my family.) Poveži z and, but, because. Vsaka poved: velika začetnica in pika.
learn.example: My brother's name is Alan. He's nine years old. He's got curly hair and he can ride a bike very well.

goals.text: Znam poimenovati 30 živil in pijač ter jih pravilno črkovati.
Znam povedati, kaj je v mojem mestu: There is … / There are …
Vem, kdaj rečem a/an, some ali any.
Ločim števno in neštevno ter vprašam How much / How many.
Znam reči, da je nečesa preveč ali premalo.
Znam naročiti hrano v kavarni in prebrati ceno.
Ponovim Starter in Unit 1: to be, me/him/them, množina, have got, can.
Napišem 13–15 pravilnih povedi o svoji družini ali prijatelju.

sections.title: Hrana in pijača (Food and drink)
sections.text: Besede iz Unit 2. Pazi na črkovanje: **sandwich, yoghurt, biscuits, vegetables, breakfast, delicious, potatoes, tomatoes**.

sections.title: Obroki (Meals)
sections.text: **breakfast** = zajtrk, **lunch** = kosilo, **dinner** = večerja. Pred obroki ni člena: *I have breakfast at seven.* Čas: *at seven o'clock, at half past twelve*.
examples: I have breakfast at 7 o'clock. A typical breakfast for me is milk and cereal.
We have lunch at school at half past twelve.
My favourite meal is dinner.

sections.title: Kraji, kjer jemo, kuhanje in trgovina
examples: Beat two eggs in a bowl.
Cut up the onion and fry it in the oil.
Boil the water and then add the pasta.
Bake the cake for twenty minutes.

ednina (1)
množina (2+)

Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

watch_out.wrong: In my town have two pizzerias.
watch_out.right: There are two pizzerias in my town.

a banana, a sandwich, a burger

sections.text: Neštevne besede iz knjige: **milk, water, juice, cola, bread, butter, cheese, bacon, ketchup, oil, salt, rice, pasta**. Te imajo *is*, ne *are*: *How much juice is there?*

sections.title: too much / too many / not enough
examples: There's too much meat on that plate. (preveč mesa)
There are too many chips. (preveč krompirčkov)
There isn't enough salt. (premalo soli)
There aren't enough chips. (premalo krompirčkov)
sections.text: Ko nečesa ni dovolj, rečemo **not enough**. Ko je nečesa preveč: **too much** (neštevno) ali **too many** (množina).

sections.text: Cene: £2.70 = *two pounds seventy (pence)*, 35p = *thirty-five pence*, £1.56 = *one pound fifty-six*.
examples: Let's buy some fruit. Good idea!
How much are the bananas? They're only 64p.
I'm starving! (zelo lačen) · Of course. · Keep an eye on it.

sections.title: Starter: to be, zaimki, množina
sections.text: To je osnova za vsak test. Glagol to be ima tri oblike: am, is, are. Zaimki se spreminjajo glede na vlogo v povedi. Pri množini se večina besed konča na -s, nekaj pa jih je posebnih: nauči se jih na pamet.
examples: Is Katie from London? No, she isn't.
Are Marie and George students? Yes, they are.
Danny and Sue are nice. Look at them!
This book is great. Those watches are old.
one child → two children, one man → two men, one woman → two women
one mouse → two mice, one wolf → two wolves, one knife → two knives

watch_out.why: V angleščini poved vedno potrebuje osebek (he, she, it).
Za glagolom in za at, to, for → me, him, her, us, them.
Posebna množina: nauči se jo na pamet.
Več stvari blizu → these, več stvari daleč → those.

sections.title: Unit 1: have got, can, 's
sections.text: To potrebuješ v sestavku o družini. He, she, it in en človek (my brother, my mum) dobijo HAS got. Can je za vse osebe enak. Čigavo je, povemo z 's: my sister's husband (mož moje sestre).

head: oblika
have got
can
rows: Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.
Yes, she can. / No, she can't.

examples: My brother has got curly hair.
We haven't got a car, but we've got two cats.
My mum can cook very well, but she can't sing.
My friend's name is Timon. Luke's car is from the USA.
Appearance: tall, short, slim, curly hair, long dark hair, blue eyes
Personality: brave, clever, friendly, funny, nervous, quiet, nice

sections.title: Popravi svoje napake
sections.text: Te napake so iz tvojih sestavkov v zvezku. Na testu stanejo največ točk, zato jih pred oddajo poišči v svojem besedilu.

head: narobe
prav
rows: In my family live four people.
There are four people in my family.
At night she play video games.
At night she plays video games.
I like playing football. / I like to play football.
My mum is very good she cooks for us.
My mum is very good. She cooks for us.

watch_out.why: too much pomeni preveč (in to ni dobro).

sections.title: Sestavek za 5: My family
sections.text: Učiteljica je v zvezek dala nalogo »My family, 13 do 15 stavkov«. Na testu pričakuj podobno: opis družine ali osebe. Uporabi zgradbo iz učbenika (Writing box 1.7): uvod, starost in od kod, videz, kaj zna, kaj ima rad, osebnost, zaključek. Preštej povedi: 13–15. Vsaka ima osebek in glagol, veliko začetnico in piko.
examples: There are four people in my family: my mum, my dad, my brother Alan and me.
We've also got two pets, a cat called Fali and a dog called Hildi.
My mum's name is Daniela. She's from Mexico.
She's very kind and she can cook very well.
My brother's name is Alan. He's got curly hair.
He can ride a bike very well, but he can't swim.
My favourite food is pizza, but there isn't any pizza at home today!
I love my family very much.

watch_out.right: There are four people in my family: my mum, my dad, my brother and me.

watch_out.why: I je vedno velik, na koncu je pika.

tasks.prompt: Kaj so v britanski angleščini »chips«?
hints: Fish and chips je znana angleška jed.
tasks.solution: **Chips** = pomfri (ocvrti krompirčki). Čips v vrečki = **crisps**.

tasks.prompt: Katera beseda NE spada zraven? carrot, celery, potato, bacon
tasks.solution: **Bacon** (slanina) je meso. Ostale so zelenjava.

tasks.prompt: Prevedi in pravilno črkuj: sendvič
tasks.solution: **sandwich** (s-a-n-d-w-i-c-h). Pazi na d in w!

tasks.prompt: Prevedi in pravilno črkuj: piškoti
accept: cookies
tasks.solution: **biscuits** (b-i-s-c-u-i-t-s).

tasks.prompt: Prevedi: zajtrk
tasks.solution: **breakfast**. Kosilo = lunch, večerja = dinner.

tasks.prompt: You can eat pizza in a …
tasks.solution: Pico ješ v **pizzeria**. Bowl je skleda.

tasks.prompt: ______ two eggs in a bowl. (stepi)
tasks.solution: **Beat** = stepati. Bake = peči v pečici, boil = kuhati v vodi.

tasks.prompt: There ______ two cafés in my street.
tasks.solution: Dva kavarni = množina → **There are** two cafés.

tasks.prompt: There's ______ egg in the fridge.
hints: Pred a, e, i, o, u pišemo an.
tasks.solution: Egg se začne s samoglasnikom e → **an egg**.

tasks.prompt: Katera beseda je NEŠTEVNA (je ne moremo prešteti)?
tasks.solution: **Milk** je neštevno: some milk, NE two milks. Banane, jajca in burgerje lahko preštejemo.

tasks.prompt: Marie and George ______ students.
hints: Koliko ljudi je? Namesto imen rečemo they.
tasks.solution: Dva človeka = they → **are**: Marie and George **are** students.

tasks.prompt: Množina: one child → two ______
tasks.solution: child → **children** (posebna množina, brez -s).

tasks.prompt: Napiši zanikano: There's a burger bar near our school.
tasks.answer: There isn't a burger bar near our school.
accept: There is not a burger bar near our school.
There isn't a burger bar near our school
tasks.solution: There is → **There isn't** a burger bar near our school.

Are there any vegetarian cafes in your town?

tasks.prompt: Dopolni z some ali any: There aren't ______ biscuits in the box.
tasks.solution: Zanikana poved → **any**: There aren't any biscuits.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni z a, an, some ali any: There's ______ bread on the table.
tasks.solution: Bread je neštevno → **some** bread (nikoli a bread).

tasks.prompt: Dopolni z a, an, some ali any: Is there ______ milk in the fridge?
tasks.solution: Vprašanje → **any**: Is there any milk?

tasks.solution: Eggs lahko preštejemo → How **many** eggs?

tasks.prompt: Dopolni z much ali many: How ______ juice is there?
tasks.solution: Juice je neštevno → How **much** juice is there?

tasks.solution: Chips je množina → **too many** chips.

tasks.solution: Premalo = **not enough**: There isn't enough milk.

There are some eggs but there is not any milk.

tasks.prompt: Dopolni z zaimkom: Danny and Sue are my friends. I like ______ a lot.
hints: Za glagolom ne rečemo they. I → me, he → him, they → …
tasks.solution: Danny and Sue = they; za glagolom pa → **them**: I like **them** a lot.

hints: Blizu ali daleč? Ena ali več?

tasks.solution: knife → **knives** (f → ves), kot wolf → wolves.

accept: Is Katie in Paris
tasks.solution: Pri to be zamenjaj vrstni red: **Is Katie in Paris?**

accept: has not got
hints: Grant's got = Grant has got. Zanikaj has.
tasks.solution: Grant = he → **hasn't got**.

tasks.solution: Pravilno: **There are four people in my family.**

challenge.prompt: Pisni sestavek, kot ga je dala učiteljica: My family (13–15 povedi). Napiši: koliko vas je, vsakega člana (ime, starost, od kod, videz s has got, kaj zna s can), hišne ljubljenčke, kaj radi jeste ali počnete skupaj in zaključek. Poveži z and, but, because. Preštej povedi.
challenge.solution:
Primer (14 povedi): There are four people in my family: my mum, my dad, my brother Alan and me. We've also got two pets, a cat called Fali and a dog called Hildi. My mum's name is Daniela and she's from Mexico. She's kind and funny. She can cook very well and her food is delicious. My dad's name is Danijel. He works on his computer and he can take great photos. My brother's name is Alan. He's got curly hair and brown eyes. He can ride his bike very well, but he can't swim. He likes playing football with me. Fali is shy and she's always hiding, but Hildi loves food. At weekends we watch films together. I love my family very much.

Preveri: 13–15 povedi, has got pri he/she, His/Her, plays/likes, pike in velike začetnice.

challenge.prompt: Pisni sestavek: My best friend (13–15 povedi). Napiši: ime, starost, od kod je, videz (has got), kaj zna (can / can't), kaj rad ima, hrano in zakaj je dober prijatelj. Uporabi His/Her in and, but.
challenge.solution:
Model (14 povedi): My best friend is Luka. He's eleven years old. He's from Ljubljana in Slovenia. He's tall and slim. He's got short brown hair and green eyes. He's got a younger sister, Ana. He can play football very well and he can run fast, but he can't swim. His favourite football player is Messi. His favourite food is pizza with cheese and ham. He doesn't like fish. There's a good pizzeria near our school and we often go there. Luka is funny, clever and friendly. He's always happy. He's a great friend!

Preveri: has got (ne have), His (ne He's), velike začetnice, piko na koncu.

parent.school_method: Wider World 1: the photos cover the Starter unit, Unit 1 (People are people) and Unit 2 (It's delicious!) up to 2.7 in the student's book, and the workbook up to 2.5. Unit 2: food, meals, places to eat, cooking, supermarket foods, prices; there is/are, a/an/some/any, countable/uncountable, how much/many, too much/many, not enough. His notebook adds to be, plurals (mice, knives, wolves), question words, have got, can and the on/in/at worksheet. The teacher's writing task is 'My family, 13 do 15 stavkov'.
typical_mistakes: "In my family live four people" → "There are four people in my family" (in both of his family texts).
"He have / He like / she play" → "He has got / He likes / she plays".
"Hes favourite" → "His favourite"; dropping the subject: "Is very brave" → "He's very brave".
Run-on sentences without a full stop; lines with no verb ("My mom, dad, brother, me.").
"too much" used for "very much" ("Hildi likes too much food").
some in negatives ("There aren't some eggs"); "How much eggs"; spelling: sandwich, biscuits, yoghurt.

car_questions.q: Countable or uncountable: milk? apples? bread? cheese?
car_questions.a: milk U, apples C, bread U, cheese U.

car_questions.q: Say in English: V hladilniku ni mleka, je pa nekaj jajc.
car_questions.a: There isn't any milk in the fridge, but there are some eggs.

car_questions.q: How much or how many: ___ eggs? ___ water?
car_questions.a: How many eggs? How much water?

car_questions.q: Say in English: V moji družini smo štirje.
car_questions.a: There are four people in my family.

car_questions.q: He's or His: ___ eleven. ___ name is Alan.
car_questions.a: He's eleven. His name is Alan.

car_questions.q: Order a burger and a cola in a café.
car_questions.a: I'd like a burger and a cola, please. / Can I have a burger and a cola, please?

tips: The writing is worth the most: have him write 'My family' by hand once more and check it against the list in the study plan.
Count the sentences with him: 13–15, each with a subject, a verb and a full stop.
While cooking, ask: How much milk is there? Are there any eggs? Is there too much salt?

oral.question: What time do you have breakfast, and what do you usually eat?
key_points: A time with at (at seven o'clock).
Two foods or drinks spelled correctly.
oral.model_answer: I have breakfast at seven o'clock. I usually have milk and cereal, and sometimes eggs.

oral.question: What places to eat are there in your town? Use there is and there are.
key_points: One negative: There isn't / aren't any …
oral.model_answer: There's a pizzeria and there are two cafés in my town. There isn't a Japanese restaurant.

oral.question: What is there in your fridge? Say two things there are and one thing there isn't.
key_points: a/an only with one countable thing.
oral.model_answer: There's some milk and there are some eggs, but there isn't any cheese.

oral.question: You are in a café. The waiter asks: What would you like? Answer and order a drink too.
key_points: I'd like … , please / Can I have …?
oral.model_answer: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please. Can I have an orange juice too?

oral.question: Tell me about your family in five sentences. How many people are there? Describe one person.
key_points: There are … people in my family (not 'In my family live').
has got for appearance of one person.
oral.model_answer: There are four people in my family. My brother's name is Alan. He's got curly hair. He can ride a bike but he can't swim. His favourite food is pizza.

oral.question: Describe your best friend: age, appearance, what he or she can do, and favourite food.
key_points: has got (not have got) for appearance.
oral.model_answer: My best friend is Timon. He's eleven years old. He's got short brown hair and green eyes. He can play football but he can't swim. His favourite food is pizza.

oral.question: Say the plurals: child, man, woman, mouse, knife, wolf.
oral.model_answer: children, men, women, mice, knives, wolves
